speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me when these symptoms of double vision and weakness first started, and have they been getting progressively worse?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any difficulty swallowing, chewing, or speaking, especially towards the end of the day? I will also request a blood test for acetylcholine receptor antibodies to confirm my suspicion. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive acetylcholine receptor antibodies confirm the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
